The '''TIE/fc starfighter''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]].

==Characteristics==
The TIE/fc starfighter, which stood for "fire control", was a variant of the [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]]. It carried only one [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]], as several [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] replaced the second laser cannon found on traditional [[TIE series/Legends|TIE]] fighters. The [[TIE/gt starfighter]] was designed to be dependent on the precise targeting information provided by the TIE/fc starfighter, though large structures could still be destroyed without the TIE/fc's assistance.

The TIE/fc was primarily designed to scan an enemy base and transmit the information back to the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|fleet]]. The fleet ships would then be able to attack the base and evade the enemy's defenses. Because of its importance, the craft was designed to be very maneuverable.
